The plate is a square plate, probably about 22-24 cm across. It holds a pile of what looks like scrambled egg whites, or possibly cooked egg white pieces, along with cubes of cantaloupe and pineapple.

Egg whites: the pile covers about half the plate and is fairly thick, so I estimate around 150 g. At roughly 52 kcal per 100 g, that is about 80 kcal.

Cantaloupe: about 8 cubes, roughly 80 g, at 34 kcal per 100 g, so about 27 kcal.

Pineapple: about 5 pieces, roughly 50 g, at 50 kcal per 100 g, so about 25 kcal.

The total is about 280 g and about 135 kcal. The egg could be whole-egg scramble, but it looks very white, so I am treating it as egg white. I'll round the energy up slightly to about 150 kcal in case there is some added fat.
